title: bromus inermis f. pellitus
intro: Bromus inermis f. pellitus, commonly known as smooth bromegrass or bunch bromegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bromus inermis f. pellitus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
